text:
Zach: Heads-up — planning to enable photon-v2 in EU then US tomorrow 09:00-10:00 PT. Need rollout order, pinlist, and deploybot heartbeat checks. Deploybot will do staged batches.
Anya: +1 to stagger by region. EU -> US-W -> US-E. Keep batch sizes small (5% -> 20% -> 50%).
Maria: Fallback ordering proposal: photon-v1-quant -> titan-lite -> model-legacy. Pin enterprise accounts to titan-lite first.
Kevin: Can we add an automated guard: if overall p95 latency > 150ms or error_rate > 0.8% for 10m, pause and notify oncall?
Zach: Yes. Who owns the rollback decision? @Anya or @Zach to confirm. Also want a canary traffic tag so we can replay if needed.
Anya: I'll own the initial rollback call for batches 1-2, Zach takes over for >=3. Add explicit abort thresholds in deploybot.
deploybot: scheduled photon-v2 enable: env=[eu,us-west,us-east] batches=[5,20,50] change_window=60m prechecks=[health,kvcache] heartbeat=30s
Kevin: Example deploybot hook we should use:
```
deploybot set --job photon-v2 --stages eu:5,20,75 --health-threshold p95:150ms,error:0.8% --pause-on-fail true
```
Maria: Also add telemetry knobs: sample rate 50% for trace/span, and export prefix photon-v2/eu for dashboards.
sre-oncall: I'll run an extra synthetic against EU canary after batch1 and keep a runbook open. If latency spike, I'll escalate immediately.
Zach: Ops checklist: 1) Push pinlist (secure flag) 2) Start deploybot job 3) Wait for heartbeat OK 4) Run synthetic 5) Promote next batch. Rollback steps in pinned doc.
Anya: Updating the pinlist now. Dropping sensitive customers into titan-lite until we validate.
Kevin: I'll prepare the rollback command snippet and a prefilled runbook. sharing in this thread shortly.
deploybot: reminder — deploy will kickoff in 22h. Use `/deploybot cancel <id>` to cancel.
Zach: Sounds good. tagging postmortem owner: @Maria (if we need it). Everyone ok with this plan? :thumbsup:
Anya: :thumbsup:
Maria: :thumbsup:
Kevin: :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: :ok_hand:
Zach: Closing thread — will post final deploy job id in morning.
